name: @fn-x/dsh-plugin-liquid-glass
description: Liquid Glass as a UI project package for dsh-ui-projects: an iOS-style translucent material, with its own first-paint sheet and its own maintenance wrapper.

uiProject.name: Liquid Glass
uiProject.description: Translucent frosted layers with the system accent and generous rounding. Real blur over the system background, in light and dark.

testItems.label: Text over the glass is comfortable to read, in light and dark
Settings opens centred over the whole window, not inside a column
Reopening dsh shows the skin on the first frame, with no flash
